issues.title: Missing Core Schema and Template Files
issues.why: The spec references 'schemas/powershell.schema.json' and 'templates/run.ps1' as the primary implementation sources, but these files are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the full text of schemas/powershell.schema.json and templates/run.ps1 in the spec module.

issues.title: Functional ACs lack 'Verifies' clauses
issues.why: While boilerplate ACs (AC-01..08) have Verifies clauses, the functional requirements (AC-RUN-01..10) mentioned in the changelog are missing from the actual AC file.
issues.fix: Add GWT-style functional acceptance criteria for CLI flags and PnP logic to 97-acceptance-criteria.md with explicit Verifies clauses.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency/Locking Specs
issues.why: The spec mentions multi-project shared pnpm stores but does not define behavior if two instances of run.ps1 attempt to prune or install to the shared store simultaneously.
issues.fix: Add a section to 02-script-reference.md defining a file-lock mechanism or 'check-then-skip' logic for shared store operations.
